page.overview:
Who is Goshiki?

Goshiki has short spiky brown hair and black eyes. He wears a green long-sleeved shirt and a light green-coloured collared shirt underneath it.

Goshiki is seen fleeing the seen after Orochimaru attacks and destroys Tanzaku Castle. He warns Naruto and Jiraiya about what happened.
